messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

input.request: Password reset in our web app. The user says they forgot their password; the web app looks up their account in the users database; the app asks the email service to send a one-time reset link; the email service delivers the email to the user; the user opens the link and chooses a new password in the app, and is signed in.

assumptions: The web app and its users database sit in one backend zone, owned by your team.
The email service is an external provider that sends the reset email.
The one-time reset link is opened in the same web app, which then accepts the new password and signs the user in.
The user is shown as an actor, and the flow starts with them forgetting their password.

reply.text:
The graph is saved. It shows the user, the web app and its users database inside your team's backend zone, and the external email service. The flow runs from the forgotten password request, through the account lookup and the emailed one-time link, to the new password and sign-in.

I assumed the email service is an external provider and that the reset link opens in the same web app. Does the graph look right, or would you like changes?
